profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at GiddyUp
profile.summary: Software engineer with experience in Cloud Engineering and Kubernetes.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: As a Senior Software Engineer at GiddyUp I play a key role in building and scaling our e-commerce platform, which serves thousands of customers. I leverage my expertise in Python and Django to develop high-impact features that enhance the user experience and drive business growth.  Beyond development, I'm deeply involved in ensuring platform reliability and performance.  A major focus has been optimizing our CDN strategy and deployment pipeline for hundreds of websites using Fastly, allowing us to deliver a fast and seamless experience to customers worldwide.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Dev Center Engineering. Working on an API hosting platform utilizing Kubernetes. Writing API services utilizing Python and Golang, and deploying on Docker images.
positions.insights: Skills: Authentication Systems · Azure DevOps · Helm (Software) · Kubernetes · Software Development

positions.title: Assistant Debate Coach
positions.description: Policy Debate coach for students in the activity for the first time. Teaching students critical thinking and research skills.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Cloud Platform Engineering team member working to deploy and manage applications in the Cloud as well as maintaining the infrastructure platform for other business partners to utilize.

positions.title: Technology Leadership Program - Software Engineer
positions.description:
On the Cloud Operations and Engineering team I utilized AngularJS and Material Design Lite while creating an internal training website for the Cloud On-Boarding team to utilize when helping application teams move to the cloud.

Utilizing AngularJS and the Bootstrap framework, helped maintain and build portions of an internal cloud management and deployment system. 

Helped create an Angular Material web application for processes a customs team needs to perform drastically improving the efficiency of this team's work.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Worked with the Thomson Reuters Findlaw team importing content into Hippo7 CMS. Worked with Perl web crawlers to gather and parse legal content into XML files. Joined the Legalstreet project team working with Grails to generate PDF documents.

positions.title: Technology Intern
positions.description: Worked with the Thomson Reuters Findlaw team on the Vendor API (VAPI) project. Worked with Spring and Java to create a RESTful API for the Findlaw service.

positions.title: Park Operations Team Lead
positions.description: Team Lead of Wild Thing/Tilt-a-whirl. Responsible for Training of employees, scheduling breaks and ensuring safe as well as efficient operation of the rides.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: University of Minnesota College of Science and Engineering
volunteerExperiences.description: Mentored a Computer Science student at the University of Minnesota. Helped to coach the mentee through Interviewing strategies and helped to find relevant classes and activities to match their interests with what the technology world is looking for in a candidate today.

company.name: University of Minnesota College of Science and Engineering

testScores.name: Advanced Placement Computer Science
testScores.description: This test was the final exam for the AP Computer Science class. This test is taken nationally by students in this class. Receiving a 4 or 5 on this test generally gets a student out of taking some introductory Computer Science classes in their University programs.

organizations.name: NASA Social
organizations.description:
NASA Social is a program which provides its attendees with information about NASA's missions and programs in order to learn from and share with others. NASA Social grants attendees media credentials to its missions in order for these people to learn from their experiences and share this knowledge with their peers.. NASA Social is the next evolution in the agency’s social media efforts.

-Behind the scenes tours and presentations at the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
-Interaction with heads of both NASA and SpaceX.
-Social Media Coverage of the SpaceX CRS-3 mission.

organizations.name: We Are... Minnesota Spirit Initiative
organizations.position: Ice Box Board Treasurer · Sep 2014 - Apr 2015
organizations.description: -Helped lead the University of Minnesota Golden Gopher Hockey student section.
